ios.desc:
Welcome to AI Game Master: The Infinite Text RPG ! Where every choice you make changes the story. You don't just read the novel you step inside it and play it ! AI Game Master is an AI text RPG that is based on your imagination and has no limits to your creativity, and storytelling. Play, create and share your favorite genres - all in one place.

Whether you are a fan of the high stake action fantasy of Dungeons & Dragons , the captivating drama of Isekai Anime Romance or evergreen stories that last forever, your choices dictate the narrative and the AI Dungeon Master will react to every choice and create the best RPG experience for you! 

[APP FEATURES]
■ Unlimited, Ad-Free Immersion: Dive deep into stories with Unlimited play and absolutely no commercial interruptions.
■ Shape Your Epic Adventure: Seamless character creation and world-building tools. You write the AI creates, no limits !
■ Deep Memory: Companions that truly remember your shared history and grow with you.
■ Best AI RPG System: Recruit companions or enemies, Get rewards fromQuests, Fight enemies & Heal party members, Item generation, XP & Level up system, Special abilities, pets, Dice and much more...
■ Multiplayer 
■ Complete Privacy Control: Keep your stories secret or publish them to the community.
■ Vibrant Community: Follow favorite creators and experience user-generated masterpieces.


[EXPLORE AN INFINITE LIBRARY OF YOUR FAVOURITE GENRES]
■ Anime & Isekai 
■ Dungeons & Dragons 
■ Horror & Apocalyptic
■ Sci-fi & Cyberpunk
■ Romance & Fairy tales
■ Superheros & Multiverse
■ And many more...

[NO SCRIPTS, JUST YOUR CHOICES]
Experience interactive fiction like never before. You can create any character with your AI Dungeon Master and immediately start your adventue , there are no predetermined plots, and no two stories are ever the same. Every narrative is entirely unique, driven solely by your decisions, leading to unexpected plot twists. You hold the pen craft the ultimate ending with your own hands. Simply type your actions, and watch the story unfold in real-time. 

[NO LIMITS, ENDLESS ROLEPLAY THAT REMEMBERS]
Fans of DnD and choose your own adventure, can enjoy our AI Dungeon Master that will create the ultimate tabletop text RPG experience. Dive into the AI Dungeon and type what you want to do, our one of a kind AI RPG system will generate it for you with Images, Narration and Videos!  Become a mage. Befriend a dragon and add it to your party. Betray the kingdom and battle the kin
